title.narrative: STITCH-India

description.narrative: As the Sustainable Textile Initiative: Together for Change (STITCH) consortium, we envision a global garment industry that contributes to an equal and just society by respecting human rights in the world of work. The global garment industry is fragmented and complex, involving many actors across the globe, with varying levels of power and influence. This activity relates to Fair Wear's work contributing to India under STITCH.

comment.narrative: As Fair Wear, we have conducted 2 researches. 1 ubdation of the sumangali guidance for brands (under review); 2) research and analysis for labour codes (the codes are yet to be released by the governemnt, therefore the analysis is not yet published).

The success story for L&A is missing because civil society organisations, NGOs and trade unions in India are seeing their L&A activities increasingly curbed by governments. It has been reported that Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) are facing unprecedented scrutiny of international funding on L&A. Therefore as STITCH we are not working actively on L&A as on 2022 due to scrutiny ,legal mandate to do L&A and lack of the contusive environment for partners to do so.
